proof_scope.full_route: Weighted hierarchy, dual certificate, weighted operations and real-weight finite termination; Theorem P; Theorem M with specified-optimum perturbation and compactness; auxiliary dual-support qualification.
proof_scope.cost_scope: Qualitative finite termination is proved. Exact arithmetic-operation counts, bit complexity and an implementation are not certified.
proof_scope.formalization: No source-specific formalization or local formal build claimed.

compilation_precision: Signed perturbation handles zero-weight proper extensions of a specified optimum.
Completed-certificate dual equality provides uniform bounds for a fixed-combinatorial-type limit.
The general dual-vertex support bound is distinguished from arbitrary constructed certificates.
The bounded matching-polytope reduction is proved without a claim for general polyhedra with lineality.
The newly-tight-edge sentence on p.129 omits the symbol w; the rewrite uses the edge weight explicitly.
Contraction reordering, minimum exposed bases, exact event sizes, ties and finite old-history termination are expanded locally.
correction_status: Compilation-supplied qualifications and expansions; no author-issued erratum is asserted.
